range_enforcement: Requested observation range was enforced locally because the seriesid endpoint returned full history despite its query parameters.
normalization: Observation dates were normalized to ISO-week Monday; only weeks present in both the regional retail and assigned spot series were retained.
unit_conversion: EIA dollars per gallon multiplied by 100 to cents per gallon.
refresh_notes: Six rows were added relative to the 2026-08-11 snapshot: three regions for each of the weeks 2026-08-03 and 2026-08-10.
The API revised eight aligned wholesale proxy values in the weeks 2019-12-30, 2020-01-20, and 2020-01-27 relative to the historical-XLS snapshot.
The preceding snapshot and provenance are preserved under data/raw/eia/2026-08-11/.
